products.name: Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multi-family residential properties (five or more units), primarily in Southern California and Washington, D.C. areas. These loans are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are serviced through in-person and digital banking channels.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate, including properties such as charter schools, community facilities, churches, and office buildings. These loans involve physical collateral, require appraisals, and are managed through regulated banking processes.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Provision of loans for the construction of affordable single-family, multi-family, and commercial real estate projects, as well as land development. These loans are physically underwritten, involve staged funding, and require ongoing project monitoring and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Commercial Lending (Non-Real Estate)
products.description: Lending to businesses secured by business assets such as inventory, receivables, machinery, and equipment. These loans are underwritten based on business cash flows and collateral, and are managed through traditional banking channels.

products.name: SBA Guaranteed Lending
products.description: Origination of loans under SBA 7(a), SBA Express, International Trade, and 504(a) programs, with federal government guarantees. These loans are underwritten to SBA standards and may be secured by real estate or business assets.

products.name: Single-Family Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and purchase of loans secured by single-family residential properties, including investor-owned properties. These loans are physically underwritten, require property appraisals, and are serviced through the bank's channels.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts including savings, checking, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit to retail and institutional customers. These services are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio Management
products.description: Investment in and management of securities such as federal agency debt, mortgage-backed securities, municipal bonds, U.S. Treasuries, SBA pools, asset-backed securities, and corporate bonds. This is managed digitally and through regulated financial channels to provide liquidity and returns.

products.name: Barzolvolimab Therapeutics
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapies targeting the KIT receptor, developed and manufactured for the treatment of mast cell mediated diseases such as chronic spontaneous urticaria, chronic inducible urticaria (cold urticaria and symptomatic dermographism), prurigo nodularis, and atopic dermatitis. Delivered via subcutaneous or intravenous administration, requiring biologic manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Bispecific Antibody Therapeutics (CDX-622 Platform)
products.description: Next-generation bispecific antibody therapies targeting inflammatory diseases by simultaneously neutralizing thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP) and depleting mast cells via stem cell factor (SCF) starvation. Developed using proprietary antibody engineering and manufactured as biologics for clinical use in conditions such as asthma and other inflammatory disorders.

products.name: Nucleic Acid Products and Services
products.description: Manufacture and supply of complex nucleic acids (including mRNA, oligonucleotides, nucleoside triphosphates), proprietary mRNA capping (CleanCap®) and poly(A) tail modification (ModTail™) technologies, and specialty enzymes for research, therapeutic, vaccine, and diagnostic applications. Includes both catalog and custom products, available in research and GMP grades, and mRNA manufacturing services from discovery to commercial scale.

products.name: Biologics Safety Testing Products and Services
products.description: Development and supply of impurity detection kits (including HCP ELISA kits, other impurity and contaminant kits, viral clearance prediction tools), ancillary reagents, and custom analytical services for detecting impurities in biopharmaceutical production. Products are used throughout drug development, regulatory approval, and commercialization.

products.name: Biopreservation Media
products.description: Proprietary, serum-free, protein-free, fully defined media products (e.g., HypoThermosol FRS, CryoStor Freeze Media) manufactured under cGMP, used to preserve and extend the shelf-life and viability of cells and tissues during sourcing, manufacturing, and distribution for cell and gene therapy applications.

products.name: Human Platelet Lysate Media
products.description: Human platelet lysate-based media for cell expansion, manufactured in cGMP clean rooms, providing an alternative to animal serum and improving downstream performance in cell and gene therapy manufacturing.

products.name: Cell Processing Containers and Systems
products.description: Closed-system rigid containers (e.g., CellSeal, CryoCase) and automated cell-processing fill machines designed for safe, high-throughput, and contamination-free handling, storage, and processing of biologic materials in cell and gene therapy workflows.

products.name: Automated Thawing Devices
products.description: Automated, water-free thawing devices (ThawSTAR line) using algorithmic programmed heating plates to consistently thaw biologic materials, reducing contamination risk and ensuring process consistency in cell and gene therapy manufacturing.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Provides a broad range of lending products to individuals, businesses, and institutions, including commercial and consumer loans, credit cards, lease financing, asset-backed lending, agricultural finance, and import/export trade finance. Delivery involves in-person, digital, and intermediary channels, and is highly regulated.

products.name: Depository Services
products.description: Offers checking accounts, savings accounts, and time certificate contracts to individuals, businesses, and institutions, delivered through branches, ATMs, digital platforms, and telephone banking. Requires regulated infrastructure and deposit insurance.

products.name: Payment and Card Services
products.description: Provides consumer and business credit cards, debit cards, stored-value cards, corporate and purchasing card services, and payment processing solutions. Delivered via physical cards, digital wallets, and integrated payment systems, requiring technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Merchant Processing Services
products.description: Delivers payment processing and related services to merchants, including transaction processing for credit, debit, and other payment types. Services are provided domestically and in select international markets, leveraging technology infrastructure.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Originates, sells, and services residential and commercial mortgages through banking offices, loan production offices, and intermediaries. Involves regulated lending, securitization, and servicing activities.

products.name: Asset Management and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Provides asset management, investment advisory, and fiduciary services to individuals, estates, foundations, corporations, and charitable organizations. Delivered through bank and trust subsidiaries, requiring licensed professionals and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Capital Markets and Investment Banking Services
products.description: Offers capital markets solutions, including securities underwriting, trading, market making, and investment banking services to institutional and corporate clients. Delivered through specialized teams and broker-dealer subsidiaries, subject to securities regulation.

products.name: Corporate Trust and Fund Administration Services
products.description: Provides corporate trust services and fund administration for mutual funds and other investment vehicles, including in select international markets. Requires specialized personnel and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Brokerage and Investment Products
products.description: Offers retail and institutional brokerage services and investment products, including securities trading and advisory, through licensed broker-dealer subsidiaries. Delivered via in-person and digital channels, subject to securities regulation.

products.name: Insurance Products and Services
products.description: Provides insurance products and services, including insurance brokerage and reinsurance of credit life insurance, primarily through non-banking subsidiaries. Requires state insurance licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers banking products and services through digital platforms, including online banking and mobile apps, enabling customers to conduct transactions, access accounts, and manage finances electronically. Requires significant technology infrastructure and cybersecurity.

products.name: Industrial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of industrial real estate properties, including warehouses and light manufacturing facilities, to external tenants. Properties are acquired, developed, and managed by the company and leased under various terms to generate rental income. Delivery requires physical ownership, property management, and compliance with real estate regulations.

products.name: Computerized CNC Machine Tools
products.description: General-purpose computerized machine tools for the metal cutting industry, including vertical and horizontal machining centers (mills), turning centers (lathes), and toolroom machines, manufactured and assembled with proprietary or industry standard controls and sold globally through distributors and direct sales.

products.name: Computer Control Systems and Software
products.description: Proprietary and industry standard computer control systems and software, including WinMax, INSPIRE+, and Autobend, sold as integral components of machine tools or as retrofit units for press brake and other applications, as well as software options for programming, automation, and productivity enhancements.

products.name: Automation Solutions (ProCobots)
products.description: Automation integration equipment and solutions, including collaborative robots (cobots), feeders, machine tending systems, and Industry 4.0-capable software, designed and assembled for job shops and manufacturing environments to automate machine tool operations.

products.name: Machine Tool Components and Accessories (LCM)
products.description: Mechanical and electro-mechanical components and accessories for machine tools, such as direct drive spindles, rotary tables, swivel heads, and electro-spindles, designed and manufactured for both internal use and external sale to OEMs and end-users.

products.name: Service Parts and Replacement Parts
products.description: Replacement parts and service parts for machine tools and related equipment, distributed globally to support installed machines and maintain operational uptime for customers.

products.name: Installation, Training, and Support Services
products.description: Installation, warranty, operator training, customer support, and applications support services provided worldwide for all machine tool products and automation solutions, delivered through a combination of company service teams and distributors.

products.name: Non-Hurco Branded Machine Tools and Related Products
products.description: Distribution and sale of non-Hurco branded machine tools and technologies, including vertical machining centers, lathes, laser cutting machines, CNC grinders, compact horizontal machining centers, metal cutting saws, CNC Swiss lathes, and related parts and consumables, sourced from other OEMs and sold through company-owned distributors.

products.name: MongoDB Atlas (Database-as-a-Service)
products.description: A fully managed, multi-cloud database-as-a-service (DBaaS) platform that provides automated provisioning, management, backup, and security for MongoDB databases, delivered via public cloud infrastructure. Customers access and use the database through a managed service interface, without managing underlying infrastructure.

products.name: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced (Self-Managed Database Platform)
products.description: A proprietary, self-managed commercial database platform for enterprise customers, including advanced security, management tools, and analytics integrations. Delivered as licensed software for deployment in cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments, requiring customer management of infrastructure.

products.name: Professional Services (Consulting and Training)
products.description: Consulting and training services to assist customers in deploying, optimizing, and expanding their use of the MongoDB platform. Delivered by in-person or remote human experts to facilitate successful customer adoption and expansion.

products.name: MongoDB Community Server (Free Database Software)
products.description: A free-to-download version of the MongoDB database, providing core database functionality for developers to experiment, build, and deploy applications. Delivered as downloadable software under open source-like licenses, with limited features compared to commercial offerings.

products.name: Integrated Data Platform Capabilities (Search, Vector Search, Time Series, Analytics, Stream Processing, Encryption)
products.description: A suite of integrated data services and features—such as search, vector search, time series data support, application-driven analytics, stream processing, and queryable encryption—delivered as part of the MongoDB platform (Atlas or Enterprise Advanced), enabling customers to address diverse application requirements within a unified environment.

products.name: AI Embedding and Reranking Models (Voyage AI)
products.description: Embedding and reranking models for AI-powered applications, integrated into the MongoDB platform to improve data retrieval accuracy and reduce AI hallucinations. Delivered as APIs and managed features within the platform, enabling customers to build and scale generative AI applications.

products.name: Commercial and Agricultural Lending
products.description: Provides loans for commercial and agricultural operations and real estate purposes, primarily within local markets. These loans require in-person human labor for underwriting and are subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers residential real estate loans to individuals and families, involving regulated underwriting and servicing processes, typically delivered through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans to individuals, including personal loans and other credit products, delivered through branch network and digital banking platforms, subject to consumer protection regulations.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers deposit products such as checking accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, direct deposits, and access to ATMs, delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides cash management solutions for businesses and institutions, including transaction processing and account management, delivered via digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Mobile and Internet Banking
products.description: Delivers digital banking services, including account access, transfers, and payments, through mobile apps and internet platforms, requiring regulated IT infrastructure.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Offers full-service investment management to individuals and institutions, involving portfolio management and advisory services, delivered by licensed professionals.

products.name: Trust and Estate Services
products.description: Provides trust administration and estate planning services, including acting as trustee or executor, delivered by specialized staff and subject to fiduciary regulations.

products.name: Tanruprubart
products.description: A targeted immunotherapy biologic that inhibits C1q to block the classical complement pathway, delivered via intravenous infusion for the treatment of complement-mediated neuroinflammatory diseases such as Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS), Huntington’s Disease (HD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Manufactured using biologic processes and administered in clinical settings.

products.name: Vonaprument
products.description: An investigational neuroprotective inhibitor of C1q and the classical complement cascade, delivered via intravitreal injection for the treatment of geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to dry age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Manufactured as a biologic and administered by ophthalmologists.

products.name: ANX1502
products.description: A novel oral small molecule inhibitor of the activated form of C1s, designed for the treatment of chronic autoimmune diseases such as cold agglutinin disease (CAD). Manufactured chemically and formulated as an oral tablet for convenient long-term administration.

products.name: ANX009
products.description: A C1q-blocking Fab fragment formulated for subcutaneous delivery, developed for the treatment of antibody-mediated autoimmune disorders such as lupus nephritis (LN). Manufactured as a biologic and administered via subcutaneous injection for chronic dosing.

products.name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) Therapeutics
products.description: Targeted therapeutics for DMD using the proprietary FORCE platform, which delivers phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PMO) payloads to muscle tissue to promote exon skipping and restore dystrophin expression. These are manufactured via conjugation of a proprietary Fab antibody to PMOs and administered intravenously.

products.name: Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1) Therapeutics
products.description: Targeted therapeutics for DM1 using the FORCE platform, which delivers antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) payloads to muscle tissue to reduce toxic nuclear DMPK RNA. These are manufactured by conjugating a proprietary Fab antibody to ASOs and administered intravenously.

products.name: Facioscapulohumeral Dystrophy (FSHD) Therapeutics
products.description: Targeted therapeutics for FSHD using the FORCE platform, which delivers small interfering RNA (siRNA) payloads to muscle tissue to reduce DUX4 expression. These are manufactured by conjugating a proprietary Fab antibody to siRNAs and administered intravenously.

products.name: Pompe Disease Therapeutics
products.description: Targeted enzyme replacement therapy for Pompe disease using the FORCE platform to deliver the GAA enzyme to muscle and CNS tissue. Manufactured by conjugating a proprietary Fab antibody to the GAA enzyme and administered intravenously.

products.name: FORCE Platform Technology Out-Licensing and Strategic Collaborations
products.description: Potential out-licensing or collaboration of the proprietary FORCE platform for the development and delivery of third-party payloads to muscle tissue, leveraging the platform's modularity and delivery capabilities. This is a business-to-business service line, not a direct therapeutic product.

products.name: MICVO (micvotabart pelidotin) Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC)
products.description: A novel antibody-drug conjugate targeting the extradomain-B of fibronectin (EDB+FN) in the tumor extracellular matrix, designed for intravenous administration to treat solid tumors, especially head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), as monotherapy or in combination with pembrolizumab. Manufactured using site-specific conjugation and delivered via infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: PYX-203 Antibody-Drug Conjugate (Anti-CD123 ADC)
products.description: An investigational antibody-drug conjugate targeting the interleukin-3 receptor (CD123), designed for the treatment of hematologic cancers. The ADC is engineered for enhanced tolerability and cancer-killing activity, with a cyclopropylpyrroloindoline (CPI) payload, and is intended for intravenous administration.

products.name: PYX-106 Anti-Siglec-15 Antibody
products.description: A fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting Siglec-15, designed to block Siglec-15 mediated suppression of T-cell proliferation and function, enhancing immune cell mediated tumor cell killing in solid tumors. Delivered via infusion in clinical settings; clinical development is currently paused.

products.name: PYX-107 (Sotigalimab) CD40 Agonist Antibody
products.description: A CD40 agonist monoclonal antibody with demonstrated anti-cancer activity, evaluated in multiple clinical trials for various solid tumors, including in combination with checkpoint inhibitors. Delivered via infusion in clinical settings; currently not actively resourced.

products.name: PYX-102 Anti-KLRG1 Antibody
products.description: An investigational immune-therapeutic monoclonal antibody targeting KLRG1, an inhibitory receptor on T cells and NK cells, intended to relieve immune inhibition in solid tumors. Delivered via infusion; in preclinical or early clinical development.

products.name: Electric Delivery Services
products.description: Delivery of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in New York City, Westchester County, southeastern New York, and northern New Jersey. Service is provided through extensive regulated transmission and distribution infrastructure, including substations, overhead and underground lines, and is subject to state utility regulation.

products.name: Gas Delivery Services
products.description: Delivery of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in New York City, Westchester County, and southeastern New York. Service is provided through regulated distribution networks, including pipelines, mains, and storage facilities, and is subject to state and federal regulation.

products.name: Steam Delivery Services
products.description: Production and delivery of steam for heating and cooling to customers in parts of Manhattan via the largest steam distribution system in the United States. Steam is produced at company-owned generating stations and distributed through a dedicated piping network.

products.name: Electric Transmission Development and Ownership
products.description: Development, investment, and ownership of electric transmission projects, primarily through Con Edison Transmission and joint ventures. These projects involve large-scale, regulated infrastructure to move electricity over long distances and are subject to FERC and state regulation.

products.name: Gas Storage and Transmission Ownership
products.description: Ownership and operation of gas storage and transmission assets, including interests in storage facilities and pipelines, primarily through Con Edison Transmission and joint ventures. These assets support the delivery of natural gas and are regulated by FERC and state agencies.

products.name: Energy Storage Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of utility-scale energy storage projects, as well as procurement of storage services through long-term contracts. These projects provide grid support and reliability, and are integrated into the electric delivery system.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full range of commercial banking services including commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate loans, deposit services, treasury management, lockbox, cash management, and merchant credit card services. These services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated financial infrastructure and in-person expertise.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Retail banking services for consumers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts, installment loans, real estate loans, lines of credit, and credit cards. Delivered via branch network, ATMs, and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and customer service personnel.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of residential mortgage loans, including fixed and adjustable-rate mortgages, construction financing, land loans, and government-insured mortgages. Involves underwriting, secondary marketing, and ongoing servicing, requiring compliance with industry and regulatory standards.

products.name: Wealth and Investment Management Services
products.description: Wealth management, investment advisory, and custodial services for individuals and institutions, including trust and estate administration, investment account management, corporate trust, institutional custody, financial and estate planning, and retirement plan services. Delivered by specialized professionals and supported by regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Antipsychotic Therapies for Schizophrenia and Bipolar I Disorder
products.description: Includes ARISTADA, ARISTADA INITIO, and LYBALVI, which are proprietary, extended-release injectable and oral antipsychotic medications manufactured and commercialized by Alkermes in the U.S. These products are produced using proprietary drug delivery technologies and require physical manufacturing and regulated distribution.

products.name: Therapies for Alcohol and Opioid Dependence
products.description: VIVITROL is a once-monthly, extended-release injectable medication for the treatment of alcohol and opioid dependence, manufactured and commercialized by Alkermes in the U.S. using polymer-based microsphere technology, requiring regulated manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: Therapies for Narcolepsy and Hypersomnolence Disorders
products.description: LUMRYZ is an extended-release oral suspension of sodium oxybate for the treatment of cataplexy or excessive daytime sleepiness in narcolepsy, commercialized in the U.S. and manufactured by third parties. Alixorexton is an investigational oral orexin 2 receptor agonist in development for narcolepsy and idiopathic hypersomnia.

products.name: Products Using Proprietary Drug Delivery Technologies (Licensed to Third Parties)
products.description: Includes long-acting injectable antipsychotics (INVEGA SUSTENNA/XEPLION, INVEGA TRINZA/TREVICTA, INVEGA HAFYERA/BYANNLI, RISPERDAL CONSTA) commercialized by Janssen worldwide, which incorporate Alkermes' proprietary microsphere and NANOCRYSTAL technologies. Alkermes manufactures RISPERDAL CONSTA microspheres and receives royalties and manufacturing revenue from these products.

products.name: Multiple Sclerosis Therapy (Licensed Product)
products.description: VUMERITY is a novel oral fumarate for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, developed by Alkermes and exclusively licensed to Biogen for worldwide commercialization. Alkermes receives royalties and previously provided manufacturing services for this product.

products.name: SUI Treasury Management Services
products.description: The company acquires, holds, manages, and periodically sells SUI tokens, providing investors with indirect, liquid, institutional-grade access to the Sui blockchain ecosystem through a publicly traded vehicle. This involves open-market purchases, negotiated agreements with the Sui Foundation, and staking activities to generate yield, all managed with regulated custodians and compliance oversight.

products.name: Staking Services (SUI Token Yield Generation)
products.description: The company stakes its SUI token holdings through third-party providers to earn yield, leveraging delegated proof-of-stake mechanisms on the Sui network. This process is managed via regulated custodians and involves risk management and liquidity monitoring.

products.name: Synthetic Stablecoin Issuance (suiUSDe)
products.description: The company issues and deploys a native synthetic dollar (suiUSDe) on the Sui Mainnet, providing stablecoin solutions for decentralized finance and other blockchain-based applications. This involves minting and managing digital assets on-chain and deploying them into DeFi vaults and protocols.

products.name: Short-Term Specialty Finance and Lending
products.description: The company provides short-term, non-bank lending solutions to private businesses, micro- and small-cap public companies, and high-net-worth individuals. These loans are typically secured or unsecured, bespoke in structure, and often collateralized, with maturities generally under nine months.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full range of commercial banking services including deposit accounts (checking, savings, NOW, money market, certificates of deposit) and lending products (real estate loans, construction loans, commercial and industrial loans, agricultural loans, installment loans) delivered through physical branches, lending offices, and digital channels. Services require regulated infrastructure, financial capital, and in-person and digital customer service.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Online and mobile banking services enabling customers to access accounts, conduct transactions, and manage finances digitally. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms and requires investment in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Specialized services for business customers to manage cash flow, including payroll direct deposit, wire transfers, and other treasury management solutions. Delivered through a combination of digital platforms and in-person support, requiring regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Safe Deposit Box Services
products.description: Provision of secure safe deposit boxes for customers to store valuables at branch locations. Requires physical infrastructure and security systems.

products.name: ITM (Interactive Teller Machine) Services
products.description: Provision of Interactive Teller Machines at branch and off-site locations, allowing customers to conduct banking transactions with remote teller assistance. Requires investment in physical and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Gene Edited Plant Traits for Major Crops
products.description: Development and licensing of proprietary gene edited plant traits (such as herbicide tolerance, disease resistance, pod shatter reduction, and yield improvement) for major agricultural crops including rice, canola, soybean, wheat, and alfalfa. Traits are developed using Cibus’ RTDS gene editing platform and integrated into customers’ elite seed genetics, with commercialization via royalty or license agreements.

products.name: Sustainable Ingredients (Including Biofragrances and Lauric Oils)
products.description: Development and partner-supported commercialization of sustainable, bio-based ingredients such as lauric oils and biofragrance products (e.g., bio-rose fragrances) using gene editing and fermentation technologies. These ingredients are targeted at consumer packaged goods companies seeking natural alternatives to synthetic or extracted ingredients.

products.name: Crude Oil
products.description: Magnolia produces crude oil through the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil reserves, primarily from wells in the Eagle Ford Shale and Austin Chalk formations in South Texas. The oil is delivered via pipeline or truck and sold to third-party purchasers and refining markets.

products.name: Natural Gas
products.description: Magnolia produces natural gas from its wells in South Texas, which is gathered and processed by third-party midstream companies and sold to various purchasers in intrastate and interstate markets. Production involves drilling, gathering, and processing infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs)
products.description: Magnolia produces natural gas liquids as a byproduct of natural gas processing. NGLs are extracted at third-party processing facilities and sold to midstream processors and other market participants. Production requires drilling, gathering, and processing infrastructure.

products.name: Self Storage Rental Services
products.description: Provision of rental storage units, including traditional, climate-controlled, and auto/RV/boat storage, to residential and commercial customers through physical properties managed and operated by the company.

products.name: Third-Party Self Storage Property Management
products.description: Management of self storage properties owned by third parties, including rebranding and operational oversight, for a fee, leveraging the company's expertise and systems.

products.name: Individual Life Insurance
products.description: Nonparticipating ordinary life insurance products, including traditional whole life, term life, and other life insurance, are manufactured and underwritten by Globe Life's subsidiaries and distributed nationwide through direct-to-consumer channels and exclusive/independent agents. These products require actuarial expertise, underwriting, and are regulated by state and federal authorities.

products.name: Supplemental Health Insurance
products.description: Limited-benefit supplemental health insurance products, including accident, cancer, critical illness, heart, intensive care, and other health products, are underwritten and distributed by Globe Life's subsidiaries to individuals and families. These products are designed to supplement existing health coverage and are sold through agents and direct channels, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Medicare Supplement Insurance
products.description: Standardized Medicare Supplement insurance plans are offered to Medicare beneficiaries to cover costs not paid by Medicare, such as deductibles and co-payments. These plans are manufactured and underwritten by Globe Life subsidiaries and distributed through agents and brokers, requiring compliance with federal standardization and state regulation.

products.name: Domain Name Registry Services
products.description: Operation and management of authoritative registries for .com, .net, .name, .cc, and certain internationalized domain names, enabling individuals and organizations to register and maintain domain names. This service is delivered through secure, highly available infrastructure and involves regulated agreements with ICANN and other authorities.

products.name: Technical and Back-End Registry Services
products.description: Provision of technical and back-end infrastructure services for third-party top-level domains, such as .edu, including secure operation of registry systems and DNS resolution. These services are delivered via proprietary software and global server infrastructure.

products.name: Root Zone Maintainer and Root Server Operations
products.description: Operation of two of the thirteen global internet root servers and performance of the Root Zone Maintainer function, ensuring the security, stability, and resiliency of the Domain Name System at its highest level. This service is delivered through specialized, highly secure infrastructure and agreements with ICANN.

products.name: Integrated Virtual Care Services
products.description: A comprehensive suite of virtual healthcare services including preventive care, primary care, urgent care, chronic care management, mental healthcare, and expert medical opinions, delivered digitally via proprietary platforms and supported by a global network of clinicians. Services are accessed through web, mobile app, and connected devices, and are primarily sold to employers, health plans, and health systems.

products.name: Virtual Mental Health Services (BetterHelp)
products.description: Online counseling and therapy services provided through a digital platform, connecting individuals with licensed mental health professionals for therapy, coaching, psychiatry, and medication management via web, mobile app, phone, and text. Includes the BetterSleep app for sleep and well-being support. Delivered direct-to-consumer and through insurance.

products.name: Virtual Care Technology and Hardware Solutions
products.description: Provision of proprietary telehealth technology platforms (such as Prism and Solo) and integrated hardware (robots, carts, tablets, set-top boxes, connected medical devices) to hospitals and health systems, enabling them to deliver virtual and hybrid care models. Includes software licenses, implementation, and support services.

products.name: Remote Patient Monitoring and Connected Devices
products.description: Programs and devices for remote monitoring of chronic conditions, such as cellular blood glucose monitors and other smart connected devices, integrated with cloud-based technology and data analytics to deliver personalized health insights and support chronic disease management.

products.name: Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of primarily Class A and lifestyle office properties in Sun Belt markets, involving physical real estate assets that are professionally managed and maintained for external tenants.

products.name: Mixed-Use Property Leasing and Development
products.description: Development, ownership, and leasing of mixed-use properties that combine office, retail, and residential spaces, delivered through physical construction and joint ventures.

products.name: Real Estate Development Services
products.description: Development of new office and mixed-use properties, including planning, construction, and stabilization of assets, delivered through in-house and joint venture capabilities.

products.name: Real Estate Investment and Disposition
products.description: Acquisition and sale of office and mixed-use properties, including opportunistic purchases and timely dispositions, requiring significant financial capital and market expertise.

products.name: Real Estate Related Lending
products.description: Provision of mortgage and mezzanine loans secured by real estate, as well as joint venture lending, involving financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Server Systems
products.description: Complete server platforms in rackmount, blade, multi-node, and embedded form factors, supporting various processor architectures and optimized for high-performance, density, and efficiency. These are physically manufactured and delivered to enterprise, cloud, and edge customers.

products.name: Storage Systems
products.description: High-density, enterprise-grade storage solutions designed for performance, efficiency, and scalability, including AI-optimized storage for large-scale training workloads. These are physical systems manufactured and delivered to customers.

products.name: Edge and IoT Systems
products.description: Compact, efficient compute platforms optimized for edge, 5G, and IoT applications, designed for low-power environments and intelligent device management. These are physical systems tailored for deployment outside traditional data centers.

products.name: Server Subsystems and Accessories
products.description: Modular server components such as boards, chassis, power supplies, and accessories, sold individually or as part of integrated solutions. These are manufactured hardware components supporting a range of server and storage configurations.

products.name: Rack-Scale Integrated Solutions
products.description: Turn-key, full-rack and cluster-level solutions integrating servers, storage, networking, racks, and liquid cooling infrastructure, designed, built, tested, and installed for large-scale data center deployments. These require physical integration and on-site delivery.

products.name: Direct Liquid Cooling Solutions
products.description: Advanced direct liquid cooling systems and infrastructure (including Cooling Distribution Units and Manifolds) for data centers, engineered to reduce power, water consumption, and operational costs. These are manufactured hardware and infrastructure products integrated into customer deployments.

products.name: Server Management Software
products.description: Open, industry-standard software suites for remote system and data center management, including monitoring, power management, and update tools, delivered digitally to manage large-scale heterogeneous environments.

products.name: Global Services and Support
products.description: Comprehensive global service offerings including installation, maintenance, warranty, on-site and remote support, and lifecycle management for server and storage systems. Delivered through in-person and remote human labor, supporting both direct and OEM customers.

products.name: Automotive Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform (Cars.com) that connects car shoppers with dealerships and OEMs, providing vehicle listings, reviews, AI-powered search tools, and digital financing features. Delivered entirely online, it serves as a third-party marketplace for buying and selling cars.

products.name: Dealer Website Solutions
products.description: Customizable, data-driven website hosting and related digital solutions for automotive dealers and OEMs, enabling them to operate digital storefronts and enhance the online car buying experience. Delivered as a SaaS platform, these websites are endorsed by most OEMs and support both U.S. and Canadian dealers.

products.name: Automotive Media Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital advertising and media products, including social media ads, machine-learning optimized campaigns, and targeted video ads, enabling dealers and OEMs to reach in-market car shoppers across Cars.com properties and external digital channels. Delivered via proprietary technology leveraging audience data and digital platforms.

products.name: Trade and Appraisal Solutions
products.description: Digital tools (e.g., AccuTrade) that enable dealers to appraise, acquire, and manage used vehicle inventory, including trade-in valuation, diagnostic scans, and wholesale auction capabilities via DealerClub. Delivered as a software platform integrated with marketplace and dealer operations.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of lending products to small-to-medium sized businesses, including traditional commercial loans, commercial real estate loans, and specialty loans such as SBA loans and yacht financing. These services require significant financial capital, regulated underwriting, and in-person relationship management.

products.name: Retail and Business Deposit Products
products.description: Offers traditional deposit products such as checking accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, and certificates of deposit to both commercial and consumer clients, including specialized deposit products for municipalities and public entities. Delivery is through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides treasury, commercial payments, and cash management services to business clients, including insured cash sweep (ICS) and certificate of deposit account registry service (CDARS) products. These are delivered via digital platforms and require regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Homeowner Association (HOA) Banking Services
products.description: Delivers specialized banking services to homeowner associations and property managers, including deposit collection, lockbox services, payment services, and lending products. These services combine digital and in-person delivery with a focus on local market expertise.

products.name: Private Client Banking Services
products.description: Offers tailored banking solutions for professionals and high-net-worth individuals, particularly those in law, medicine, and related fields. Services include customized deposit and lending products, delivered through relationship managers and digital channels.

products.name: Correspondent Banking Services
products.description: Provides correspondent banking services to banks in Latin America and the Caribbean, including cross-border payment processing and compliance support. Requires specialized compliance infrastructure and international banking expertise.

products.name: Title Insurance Services
products.description: Through its subsidiary, offers title insurance policies for real estate transactions closed at the bank. This service is regulated and requires licensed personnel and compliance with state insurance regulations.

products.name: VIVO System
products.description: A non-invasive imaging system for 3D cardiac mapping, used to localize the origin of ventricular arrhythmias prior to electrophysiology procedures. The system includes proprietary software, a 3D camera, and disposable positioning patches, and is manufactured and assembled at the company's facility.

products.name: LockeT Suture Retention Device
products.description: A sterile, Class I suture retention device designed to distribute suture tension over a larger area to aid wound healing, temporarily secure sutures, and promote hemostasis. Manufacturing and fulfillment are subcontracted to a third-party provider.

products.name: Cardiac Pulmonary Nerve Stimulation (CPNS) System
products.description: A novel technology for late-stage treatment of acute decompensated heart failure by stimulating autonomic cardiac nerves to restore autonomic balance. The system was acquired and is currently held by the Cardionomix subsidiary, with future development dependent on external financing.

products.name: KardioNav Cardiac Device Interface System (in development)
products.description: A system under development intended to integrate non-invasive cardiac mapping technology with interfaces for implanted cardiac devices, enabling improved pre-ablation mapping and more precise localization of arrhythmogenic tissue. Development is led by the KardioNav subsidiary, which has its own financing.

products.name: Amigo Remote Catheter System
products.description: A robotic arm catheter control device designed to assist in the manipulation of cardiac catheters during electrophysiology procedures. The company owns the intellectual property and is considering future research and development for a next-generation product.

products.name: FLYTE Private Aviation Charter Service
products.description: A private aviation charter business operated as a subsidiary, providing air transportation services. This business is part of the company's holding structure and is intended to generate profitable growth alongside the core medical device business.

products.name: Homebuilding (Single-Family Homes and Townhomes)
products.description: Designs, constructs, and sells single-family detached homes and attached townhomes in planned development and mixed-use communities, using in-person labor, physical materials, and regulated construction processes. Homes are offered across a wide range of price points and sizes, with options for customization and energy efficiency.

products.name: Land and Lot Sales
products.description: Sells developed land and lots, primarily as a byproduct of homebuilding operations, involving acquisition, development, and sale of land parcels to external parties.

products.name: Mortgage Origination Services
products.description: Provides mortgage banking services to homebuyers, including origination and sale of mortgage loans, through a wholly-owned subsidiary, requiring financial capital, regulatory compliance, and coordination with federal agencies.

products.name: Title and Closing Services
products.description: Offers title insurance policies, title examination, and closing services to homebuyers, delivered through wholly-owned subsidiaries, involving regulated processes and coordination with home sales.

products.name: Denny's Full-Service Restaurant Dining
products.description: Operation and franchising of Denny's branded full-service restaurants offering a wide variety of breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night menu items, served in physical restaurant locations with in-person human labor and regulated food service infrastructure.

products.name: Keke’s Breakfast Cafe Restaurant Dining
products.description: Operation and franchising of Keke’s Breakfast Cafe branded daytime restaurants specializing in made-to-order breakfast and lunch items, prepared with fresh ingredients and served in physical locations with in-person service.

products.name: Off-Premises Restaurant Sales (Takeout and Delivery)
products.description: Provision of Denny’s and Keke’s menu items for off-premises consumption through takeout, curbside pickup, and delivery, enabled by digital ordering platforms and third-party delivery providers.

products.name: Restaurant Franchising Services
products.description: Sale of franchise rights and ongoing support services for Denny’s and Keke’s restaurant brands, including site selection, training, marketing, and operational guidance, governed by franchise agreements and royalty structures.
